title: Wynncraft Roach Exterminator
description: A resource pack to make all ambient cockroaches on Wynncraft invisible by removing their textures.
body:
## Wynncraft Roach Exterminator

This is a resource pack I created to help a friend who has a severe adversion to cockroaches play through Wynncraft comfortably without having to feel uncomfortable whenever in regions with ambient roach mobs.

## How to use

  To function, this pack MUST be overwriting the server resource pack - I personally achieve this throough the use of [Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils) and a mod such as [Server Pack Unlocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/server-pack-unlocker) so you can put this modified pack on top of the original one once you join the game, much like how other packs (such as [Wynn Arachnophobia](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wynn-arachnophobia)) function.

## How it works

  This pack works by overwriting the texture for roaches with an empty image, making them invisible to the player. As such, no modifications to vanilla textures will occur while using the pack.
